files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Tiles of different sizes in one grid: the large and wide tiles hold the important features. Sizes come from
  the data (large, wide, small). Axes: layout (bento, even: all tiles alike), media (none, image: a picture in
  the large tiles), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Tile } from "./bento-grid.types";

export type BentoGridProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  tiles: Tile[];
  empty?: string;
  layout?: "bento" | "even";
  media?: "none" | "image";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Card from "../compose/Card.vue";
import CardContent from "../compose/CardContent.vue";
import Grid from "../compose/Grid.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { at, cn } from "../utils";

const SPAN: Record<string, string> = {
  "large": "md:col-span-2 md:row-span-2",
  "wide": "md:col-span-2",
  "small": "",
};
const {
  id,
  title,
  tiles,
  empty = "",
  layout = "bento",
  media = "none",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<BentoGridProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :tone="tone" :density="density" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <EmptyState v-if="((tiles?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="layout-dashboard" :title="empty" />
    <Grid v-else cols="1-4" class="auto-rows-fr gap-4" data-slot="items">
      <Card v-for="tile in tiles" :key="tile.id"
        variant="default"
        :class="cn(
          'h-full overflow-hidden',
          (((density as string) === 'compact') ? 'gap-4 p-4' : ''),
          (((layout as string) === 'bento') ? at(SPAN, tile.size) : '')
        )"
        :data-size="(((layout as string) === 'bento') ? tile.size : 'even')"
      >
        <CardContent class="flex h-full flex-col gap-4">
          <LucideIcon :name="tile.icon" :size="24" />
          <Title :as="3" size="xl" weight="bold">
            {{ tile.title }}
          </Title>
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ tile.text }}
          </Text>
          <MediaFrame
            v-if="(((media as string) === 'image') && ((tile.size === 'large') || ((layout as string) === 'even')))"
            :alt="tile.title"
            ratio="4/3"
            class="mt-auto"
          />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </Grid>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
